exams.name: ACF Certified Chef de Cuisine
exams.blurb: Credential for chefs supervising a single kitchen unit, combining written testing, practical cooking and management coursework.

exams.name: ACF Certified Culinarian
exams.blurb: Entry professional cook credential requiring written and practical examinations plus documented commercial kitchen experience.

exams.name: ACF Certified Culinary Administrator
exams.blurb: Executive-level credential for culinary operations leaders covering business management, human resources and food service strategy.

exams.name: ACF Certified Culinary Educator
exams.blurb: Credential for post-secondary culinary instructors combining cooking practical assessment with teaching and curriculum evaluation.

exams.name: ACF Certified Executive Chef
exams.blurb: Senior credential for chefs managing multi-outlet kitchens, assessed on advanced cookery, nutrition, cost control and supervision.

exams.name: ACF Certified Executive Pastry Chef
exams.blurb: Senior pastry credential covering department management, advanced showpiece work, plated desserts and production costing.

exams.name: ACF Certified Fundamentals Cook
exams.blurb: Graduate-level entry credential for culinary school leavers assessed on basic cooking methods, sanitation and knife skills.

exams.name: ACF Certified Fundamentals Pastry Cook
exams.blurb: Entry pastry credential for programme graduates covering doughs, batters, custards, sanitation and basic decoration work.

exams.name: ACF Certified Master Chef
exams.blurb: Highest ACF credential awarded after an eight-day practical examination spanning global cuisines, baking, nutrition and buffet work.

exams.name: ACF Certified Master Pastry Chef
exams.blurb: Highest pastry credential requiring a multi-day practical spanning chocolate, sugar, plated desserts, breads and showpieces.

exams.name: ACF Certified Pastry Culinarian
exams.blurb: Entry pastry professional credential assessed on cakes, doughs, creams, sanitation and bakeshop production fundamentals.

exams.name: ACF Certified Secondary Culinary Educator
exams.blurb: Credential for high school culinary teachers combining cooking practical assessment with secondary teaching competency review.

exams.name: ACF Certified Sous Chef
exams.blurb: Supervisory kitchen credential assessed on production cooking, station management, food cost basics and sanitation leadership.

exams.name: ACF Certified Working Pastry Chef
exams.blurb: Mid-level pastry credential for chefs supervising bakeshop staff, covering production planning, decoration and cost control.

exams.name: Certified Food and Beverage Executive
exams.blurb: Credential for hotel food and beverage directors covering outlet operations, cost control, service standards and staffing.

exams.name: Certified Front Desk Representative
exams.blurb: Line-level credential covering reservations, check-in and check-out, guest requests, payment handling and property systems.

exams.name: Certified Guest Service Professional
exams.blurb: Entry hospitality credential focused on guest interaction standards, problem resolution and service recovery techniques.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Department Trainer
exams.blurb: Credential for hotel staff who deliver on-the-job training, covering task breakdowns, coaching and performance follow-up.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Housekeeping Executive
exams.blurb: Credential for executive housekeepers covering staffing, inventory, cleaning standards, safety and budget management.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Revenue Manager
exams.blurb: Credential covering hotel demand forecasting, rate strategy, distribution channels and revenue performance measurement.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Sales Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for hotel sales staff covering prospecting, group business, contract negotiation and account management practice.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Supervisor
exams.blurb: Supervisory credential covering scheduling, coaching, conflict handling and departmental communication in lodging operations.

exams.name: Certified Hotel Administrator
exams.blurb: Flagship credential for general managers and hotel executives, examining rooms, food service, finance, marketing and leadership.

exams.name: Certified Rooms Division Executive
exams.blurb: Credential for rooms division leaders covering front office, housekeeping, reservations, yield management and guest services.

exams.name: ServSafe Alcohol Advanced Certification
exams.blurb: Advanced responsible alcohol service examination for managers covering policy, documentation, intervention and liability exposure.

exams.name: ServSafe Alcohol Primary Certification
exams.blurb: Responsible alcohol service training and examination on intoxication assessment, identification checks and refusal techniques.

exams.name: ServSafe Allergens Certification
exams.blurb: Online course and assessment on major food allergens, cross-contact prevention, labelling and guest communication procedures.

exams.name: ServSafe Food Handler Certificate
exams.blurb: Entry-level food safety course and assessment for line staff covering hygiene, time and temperature control and cleaning.

exams.name: ServSafe Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.blurb: Most widely accepted ANSI-CFP accredited manager food safety examination, valid five years in most United States jurisdictions.

exams.name: ServSafe Workplace
exams.blurb: Training suite for restaurant employers covering harassment prevention, unconscious bias and workplace conduct expectations.

exams.name: Advanced Cicerone
exams.blurb: Third-level beer credential with written, tasting and demonstration components covering brewing, service and off-flavour analysis.

exams.name: Certified Beer Server
exams.blurb: First-level beer credential testing storage, draught service, styles and off-flavours for front-line hospitality staff.

exams.name: Certified Cicerone
exams.blurb: Second-level beer credential combining written, tasting and demonstration testing on styles, service, pairing and draught systems.

exams.name: Master Cicerone
exams.blurb: Highest beer credential with a two-day written, tasting and oral examination held for a small number of candidates each year.

exams.name: Advanced Sommelier Certificate
exams.blurb: Third-level sommelier examination with theory, blind tasting and service components required before attempting the Master diploma.

exams.name: Certified Sommelier Examination
exams.blurb: Second-level sommelier examination testing theory, deductive blind tasting and restaurant wine service under timed conditions.

exams.name: Introductory Sommelier Course and Examination
exams.blurb: Two-day course and written examination introducing wine regions, viticulture, spirits and professional beverage service.

exams.name: Master Sommelier Diploma Examination
exams.blurb: Final sommelier examination with oral theory, blind tasting of six wines and practical service, passed by very few candidates.
